title: Foundryshop
description: A Photoshop-style drawing and layers toolbox for GMs: a floating tool palette with brush presets, nested layers and groups with GM/player visibility, presentation presets, textured materials, stamps, map labels, tracing references, project export/import, and an advanced color picker. Originally based on Boneyard Drawing Tools by Lich (operation404), MIT licensed.

requires.reason: Foundryshop relies on Precise Drawing Tools for high-resolution drawing; without it, drawn artwork is noticeably lower quality.
